title: Benefit and Cost of Random-Token Replacement under Repeated Data: A Known-Entropy Decomposition and Evidence from Ten Real Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2610.27590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When unique pretraining data is scarce, models see the same tokens many times and are thought to memorize. Random-token replacement, an input-corruption augmentation, is one remedy reported to lower validation loss, but a lower loss alone does not reveal which source of error it reduces. On a controlled source whose entropy rate is known in closed form, we show that replacement shrinks predictions toward the corpus average. We also introduce a decomposition that separates validation loss into approximation, estimation, and memorization terms. This shrinkage view predicts that replacement's bias cost needs no memorization but its benefit does. Memorization raises validation loss after its minimum, so we report the effect at two points, the minimum validation loss and the end of a fixed budget. translated_title: 重复数据下随机词元替换的收益与代价：基于已知熵的损失分解及来自十个真实语料库的证据
translated_abstract: 当独一无二的预训练数据稀缺时，模型会反复见到相同的词元，因而被认为产生了记忆化。随机词元替换是一种输入污染式数据增强手段，据报导可降低验证损失，但仅凭验证损失的下降并不能揭示它究竟减少了哪一类误差来源。在一个熵率具有闭式表达式的受控数据源上，我们证明替换会使预测向语料库平均值收缩。我们还引入了一种分解方法，将验证损失拆分为近似项、估计项与记忆项。这一收缩视角预言：替换的偏差代价无需记忆化即可出现，而其收益则依赖记忆化。由于记忆化会使验证损失在达到最小值后再度上升，我们在两个时点报告替换的效果：验证损失最小值处以及固定训练预算结束时。在替换有帮助的情形下，它将该回升幅度降低约60%。在预算结束时，随着受控数据源b……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将验证损失分解为近似、估计与记忆三项的框架，在熵率已知的受控数据源上证明随机词元替换通过向语料均值收缩预测来缓解记忆化（可将验证损失最小值后的回升降低约60%），其收益依赖记忆化的存在而偏差代价则不然，并在十个真实语料库上提供了实证证据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decomposition of validation loss into approximation, estimation, and memorization terms, showing on a controlled source with known closed-form entropy that random-token replacement mitigates memorization by shrinking predictions toward the corpus average (reducing the post-minimum loss rise by about 60%), with its benefit requiring memorization while its bias cost does not, supported by evidence from ten real corpora.
